note: Curated fleet lists for the competitor tracker. David can add a company or ships by editing this file (see README). The hourly refresh may add ships or fill MMSIs when AISstream reports a matching name or IMO; it does not delete rows. Lists are not a complete census. Sources are official company pages and Wikidata (CC0), plus later AIS name matches.

fleets.name: Borchard Lines
fleets.expected_note: 10 chartered containerships on the company's vessels page (checked 10 Nov 2026).
fleets.note: Complete list from the official fleet page. All are chartered, so an owner number would not find them. Call signs as published (Joanna and Judith are both shown as CQ2049 on that page).

fleets.name: Maersk
